heroHeading: Our island wear started life as a beach towel..
heroBody: XUGA up-cycles retired beach towels into island wear made to last. Every piece is unique, just like you!

howSteps.title: You find a piece you love
howSteps.body: Each one is sewn by hand from a single retired beach towel. No two are alike, because no two towels are.

howSteps.title: It carries a small tag
howSteps.body: Sewn into every garment is a fabric tag with a code, the kind that brought you to this page.

howSteps.title: The towel tells its tale
howSteps.body: Scan it and you meet the towel: where it spent its summers, who rescued it, and what it became.

meetBody: Three towels, three second lives. Pick one and hear it out.
closingBody: Each XUGA piece is one of one. When you buy it, the tale becomes yours to carry.
